Pauṣkarasaṃhitā
pāñcarātra. relating to initiation etc.; in 43 adhys; counted a. one among the Pāñcarātra gems. For its contents see Daniel Smith, Bibl. of Pāñcarātrāgama I. p.. 277-96. Some mss. claim it a. forming part of Nāradapāñcarātra.
C.. NCC. X. p.. 55b-56a.
Adyar II. p. 181a (2 mss.: 1-22; 23-43). Baroda II. 11484. BC. 148 (adhys. 1-4. 6-9. 11. 42). BP. p. 8. C.. V. 39 (adhys. 1-37). Gough p. 168 (adhys. 30-45). IO. 2531 (adhys. 1-43). 6139. Mysore 3. Oppert II. 4071. R. A. Sastri I. p.. 127. 128. 130. II. p. 169. III. p. 259 (adhy. 43).
Mentioned in Pādmatantra, IO. 2532.
Pt.. ed. by Yatiraja Sampatkumara Ramanujamuni of Melkote. Bangalore, 1934.

Pauṣkarasādi
grammarian. Q. in Taittirīyaprātiśākhya 5, 37. 38; 13, 16; [Page206-b] 14, 2; 17, 6; by Kātyāyana in Vārttika 3 to Pāṇini VIII. 4, 48 an. Maitrāyaṇīyaprātiśākhya 5, 39. 40; 2. 1. 16; 2. 5. 6. See Y. Mimamsak, Sam3s. Vyākaraṇ Śāstra kā Itihās I. p. 70; ref. to by Śaurisūnu in his Naparataparalakṣaṇa, TCD. 35C; by Ayyāśāstri in his Saptasvarasindhu, TCD. 33.
For Ācārya Pauṣkarasādi an. the date of Pāṇini, see M. S. Bhat, J. of Ori. Inst., M. S. Uni. VIII (1959) p.. 385 ff.

Pauṣkarāgama
śai. Upāgama; said to be supplement to Pārameśvarāgama, the 26th Mūlāgama.
Adyar II. p. 189b (inc.). Baroda II. 6827 (e). BC. 132. Gough p. 168. IO. 2606 (A) (Jñānapāda in 8 paṭalas). MD. 5459. 5460 (both Jñānapāda in 8 paṭalas). Mysore 4. R. A. Sastri I. p. 18. II. p. 172. IV. p. 261. Taylor II. p. 425 (Jñānapāda in 8 paṭalas). TD. 15336 (inc.).
Q. by Abhinavagupta in Tantrāloka X. p. 101; by Rāmakaṇṭha in C. on Nareśvaraparīkṣā, Kas. Texts XLV. p. 256; by Nārāyaṇakaṇṭha in C. on Mṛgendrāgama, Kas. Texts L. p. 95; by Sāyaṇa in Sarvadarśanasaṅgraha, Ānandāśrama edn. p. 68; by Utpala in Spandapradīpikā, Viz. Skt. Ser. 16. p. 3.
Pt.. (1) in Grantha an. Tamil scripts with Tamil explanation. Sivajnanabodha Press. Madras, [1890]. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1910. (2) Vidyāpāda (Jñānapāda) with C. by Umāpatiśivācārya in Grantha script. Chidambaram, 1925.
--C. Adyar II. p. 189b (inc.). Mysore 4 (Jñānapāda). [Page207-a.
--C. by Umāpatiśivācārya. BC. 132. Hz. II. 968. Extr. p. 83. Mysore 3. R. A. Sastri II. p. 211.
The a. is a younger contemporary of Maraijñānadeśikar an. Śivāgrayogin, to whose C.s he refers. See V. A. Devasenapathi, Śaivasiddhānta p. 11.
See also Potter, Encycl. of Ind. Phil. p.. 462-3.
--C. by Jñānaśivācārya. IO. 6143 (Jñānapāda).
Prob. identical with Jñānaprakāśācārya, a. of Śivayogasāra, NCC. VII. p. 328b.
Jñānaprakāśācārya is credited with the following works also: Ajñānavivecana, Pramāṇadīpikā, Prasādadīpikā, Śivayogaratna, Śivasamādhimāhātmyasaṅgraha an. Siddhāntaśikhā maṇi.

Ref. to a. a. author of a surgical work. See Atridev Vidyalankar, Āyurved kā Bṛhat Itihās p. 203.
